name: search-distill-smoke
integrity_checks: real game: the engine's return code on every step
real game: hard counters after every step and at the end (illegal, projection_collision, error_episodes, rejected_submissions, precheck_collisions)
real game: both seats' logits and values finite on every step
real game: the opponent-view state and value finite on every step
real game: both seats' emitted rewards finite and within the clip threshold on every step
real game: the game ends in a natural match end (STATUS_MATCH_OVER), not on the decision cap
rollouts: the engine's return code and status on every step
rollouts: the same hard counters of every clone at its rollout's end
rollouts: both seats' emitted rewards finite and within the clip threshold on every step
rollouts: logits and values finite on every forward
rollouts: no mask fallback, and an action selectable at every decision
rollouts: no rollout fails; a rollout stops on a turn end, the match end, the 200-step cut-off or the inherited decision cap
search: every return the deviation rule reads is finite

play.opponent: the same checkpoint under the same masks, sampling seed offset by one stride

split.reserve: never written by the dataset tool under this plan

finetune.precision: float64 training on float32 features; the blob is float32
finetune.loss: [lambda * sum over deviation roots of w * (-log p(label)) + sum over the other loss decisions of w * KL(p0 || p)] / (sum of w); KL over the tuples of the joint support; a step uses one chunk's numerator over (the training set's weight / the number of chunks)

fit.statistic: weighted mean probability of the label on training deviation roots, from float32 logits as the harness computes them

selection.rule: SELECTION.json is written only when all three arms' blobs pass acceptance and Reading 1 is FIT; the registered arm is the named one; if any arm's blob fails acceptance the plan stops unread at the selection and no gate is played

diagnostic.statistic: J = q * M * g - price * U on the validation games, no rollouts
diagnostic.note: reported for every arm; it decides nothing
